        }

        }
    }
}

    datacenter /Common/dc_sby

        10.2.5.5 { }
    }

    virtual-servers {

            destination 10.2.5.6:80
        }
    }
}

    load-balancing-mode topology
    members {
        /Common/bigip_jkt:vs_web {
            member-order 0
        }

        }

        /Common/bigip_jkt:vs_api {
            member-order 0

        /Common/srv_off:vs1 {
            member-order 1
        }

    monitor /Common/https
}

    members {
        /Common/bigip_sby:vs_web { }
    }
}
gtm wideip a /Common/www.example.com {
    pool-lb-mode topology
    pools {
        /Common/pool_web_a {
            order 0
        }
    }
    last-resort-pool a /Common/pool_api_a
}

            order 0
        }
    }

        /Common/pool_web_a {
            order 0
        }
    }
}
